instruction: Hey, quick question: What carrier do you use? (order #10593)
output: Good question. Domestic orders go via USPS or UPS depending on weight and destination. Express orders always ship UPS. International orders ship via DHL.

instruction: Hi there, I ordered two items but only one arrived. (order #10593)
output: Multi-item orders sometimes ship in separate boxes. Check your Shipping page for tracking numbers per package. If the second tracking shows nothing within 5 business days, tell me and I'll reship it.

instruction: Do you have a status page?
output: Good question. Yes, status.pondlite.example shows real-time uptime and incident history. You can subscribe to email or Slack alerts there.

instruction: URGENT: Do you offer refunds within 30 days?
output: Thanks for reaching out! Yes, we have a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Reply with your order number and I'll process the refund to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

instruction: Hi there, I'm getting a suspicious login alert. (order #10801)
output: Thanks for reaching out! If it was you, ignore it. If not, reset your password immediately from the sign-in page, then enable two-factor authentication in Settings > Security. I'll also force a logout of all your sessions now.

instruction: Hi there, I ordered two items but only one arrived.
output: Happy to help. Multi-item orders sometimes ship in separate boxes. Check your Shipping page for tracking numbers per package. If the second tracking shows nothing within 5 business days, tell me and I'll reship it.

instruction: URGENT: Can I use your API?
output: Yes. Generate an API key under Settings > API. Rate limits are 60 requests per minute on paid plans and 10 per minute on free.

instruction: Hi there, How is my usage billed?
output: Thanks for reaching out! Paid plans bill per active seat per month. Usage above your plan's quota is metered and shown on the Usage page before it's invoiced.

instruction: Hi there, My order arrived damaged. (order #10617)
output: Thanks for reaching out! I'm sorry about that. Reply with a photo of the damaged item and the box, and I'll ship a replacement today. No need to return the damaged unit.

instruction: Hi there, Can I pick up my order locally? (order #10617)
output: Hi Nina, thanks for writing in. Local pickup is available at our two fulfillment stores in Austin and Portland. Select Store pickup at checkout and you'll get an email when it's ready, usually same day.

instruction: Hi team, Why was I charged twice for my subscription? (order #10801)
output: Good question. I checked your account and I'm seeing only one active subscription. The double charge is usually a pre-authorization from your bank that drops off within 3 business days. If it's still there after that, reply here and I'll open a refund request.

instruction: Can I change the email on my account?

instruction: Hi there, How much is shipping? (order #10593)

instruction: URGENT: How do I cancel my subscription?
output: You can cancel anytime from Settings > Billing > Manage plan > Cancel. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing cycle, and you won't be charged again.

instruction: Hey, quick question: How do I reset my workspace?
output: Workspace admins can go to Settings > Workspace > Danger zone > Reset workspace. This clears all projects but keeps members and billing. It cannot be undone.

instruction: What browsers do you support?
output: Hi Ava, thanks for writing in. The latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

instruction: Hi team, What languages do you support?

instruction: Hey, quick question: Why can't I log in? (order #10617)

instruction: Hello, Does your app work offline? (order #10744)
output: Hi Sam, thanks for writing in. Yes. The mobile apps cache your last 30 days of data for offline viewing, and edits sync automatically when you reconnect.

instruction: URGENT: What are your support hours?

instruction: URGENT: Why did my price go up this month? (order #10617)

instruction: Hey, quick question: How do I delete my account? (order #10744)
output: Happy to help. Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Enter your password to confirm. Data is purged from our live systems within 24 hours and from backups after 30 days. This can't be undone.
